capture: Retains translated vertex SPIR-V, vertex constants, decoded indices, guest vertex-fetch bytes, and source raster/scissor for recognized PM4 rectangle-list Copy/Convert draws.
Uses the actual captured Copy/Convert draw geometry with the existing format-specific resolve fragment shader.
Ordered operation replay rejects missing Copy/Convert geometry instead of substituting a fullscreen triangle.
Cached destination images use LOAD on subsequent partial writes after initialization.
The exact-layout Copy/Convert guard prints active draw and Copy source EDRAM fields when it rejects a packet.
change.diagnostics: Copy packet logs include topology, index count, AutoIndex, vertex/index byte counts, input attribute count, and source scissor. Layout mismatch diagnostics include color/depth bases, guest and translated formats, extent, pitch, samples, and depth-only state.

regressions: Synthetic indexed rectangle-list Copy/Convert uses captured geometry.
Ordered stream refuses Copy/Convert with missing captured geometry.
A zero-area captured scissor preserves the initialized non-black destination.
A mismatched Copy source layout diagnostic reports both source and active draw EDRAM layouts.

limitations: No retail capture was run in this turn because ADB lists no connected device.
The 14-draw retail transition still fails closed at packet 49's EDRAM source-layout mismatch; shared physical EDRAM backing and tile/sample transfer across aliases are not implemented.
The format-specific Copy/Convert fragment shader has not been verified against an original retail image or complete 14-draw execution.
Depth/stencil and clear-side-effect preservation across the full transition remain incomplete.
Exact PM4_INTERRUPT packet-to-guest-dispatcher-entry crosswalk remains unproven.
